title: Term Life Insurance Conversion Privilege
content:
**Contract provision — conversion of Term Life Insurance to an Ashgrove permanent policy.**

1. **Privilege.** The owner may convert term coverage to an Ashgrove permanent policy without evidence of insurability.
2. **Deadline.** Conversion must be signed no later than the conversion deadline, which is the issue date plus the product's conversion period in months. The deadline is found by adding the number of calendar months to the issue date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; a conversion application signed on the deadline is in time. The issue date is read from the policy record and compared with the signed date of the conversion application.
3. **Age limit.** Independently, conversion is no longer available from the policy anniversary on or after the insured's attained age reaches the product's conversion age limit; the earlier of the two dates governs.
4. **Application.** The term policy is converted only on a conversion application signed by the owner whose request status is approved.
5. **Status.** The policy must be in force on the conversion date: a policy in its grace period is converted only after the overdue premium is paid and it is back in force.
6. **Products.** Within the product's full-menu period from the issue date the new product may be any tier on the full-menu list; after that only the designated products.
7. **Face converted.** The converted face amount must be at least the product's smallest conversion face and may not exceed the term face amount. Converting the whole face ends the term policy as converted; converting part of the face reduces the term face by the converted amount, and the term face remaining may not fall below the tier's smallest face amount.
8. **New policy.** The new policy is issued on the conversion date at the insured's attained age, in the same underwriting class, with the waiver of premium rider only if the term policy carried it.
9. **Conversion credit.** A conversion signed in a policy year from the product's first to last credit policy year earns a conversion credit of the product's credit share of the converted face premium — the converted face divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000, times the band factor for the term face in force immediately before conversion, rounded to the cent — and the credit is also rounded to the cent and applied to the new policy's first premium. No credit is earned in other policy years and none is ever paid in cash.
10. **Waiver in progress.** A conversion requested while premiums are being waived under the waiver of premium rider is not decided by policy service.

### Deadline — hypothetical boundary

| Issue date | Conversion period | Deadline | Signed on deadline | Signed the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 29 February 2016 | 120 months | 28 February 2026 | in time | not in time |
| 12 April 2015 | 180 months | 12 April 2030 | in time | not in time |

### Partial conversion — hypothetical

On a term face of 150000 with a smallest face of 100000, converting 25000 leaves 125000 (allowed); converting 60000 would leave 90000, below the smallest face (not allowed). Converting 20000 is below a smallest conversion face of 25000 (not allowed).
